learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should not propagate to the final verdict as 'inconclusive' when other models have successfully reviewed the same files. The adjudication layer should recognize tool failures and discount them rather than treating them as substantive uncertainty.

When a model fails mid-audit due to infrastructure errors, the system should either retry the failed file or clearly distinguish between 'inconclusive due to analysis uncertainty' and 'inconclusive due to tool failure' in the report metadata.
